videos.script: Two servers on the same switch talk to each other freely. No firewall between zones can see it. {{switch}} Microsegmentation puts a wall around every machine instead. What makes that bearable is writing the policy once, by role, and generating each machine's rules from it. {{policy}} In this lesson a short program turns a table of roles into host firewalls, and every conversation between the servers is tested. {{test}} Then the harder part. The application is withdrawn from the database while a session is open, and the session keeps working. {{gap}} Ending access means ending what is already open, and you will see what that takes. {{cut}}
